issue_context.title: [Bug]: Memory Consumption Issue with Playwright 1.44.1- Assistance Required
issue_context.body: ### Version 1.44.1 ### Steps to reproduce We have created a minimal repository to demonstrate the issue, with the following branches: ```memory-uses-for-playwright-1.41``` (Playwright 1.41) ```memory-uses-for-playwright-1.42``` (Playwright 1.42) **Repository Link:** [GitHub - Pooj123-A/playwright-memory-issue](https://github.com/Pooj123-A/playwright-memory-issue/tree/main) **Reproduction Steps:** 1. Clone the repository. 2. Install dependencies: ```npm install```. 3. Run tests: ```npm run profile-test src/test.spec.tsx (for profiling)``` or ```npm run test src/test.spec.tsx(for normal execution).``` ### Analysis Instructions: The npm run profile-test script is designed for profiling with pprof. After running the tests, you can visualize memory profiles using pprof: ### Install Go and pprof if not already installed: ```brew install go``` ### Use pprof to start a local web server for profile visualization: ```go tool pprof -http=:8080 pprof-heap-.pb.gz``` ***By comparing the profiles for Playwright 1.41.1 and 1.42+, you will observe differences in memory usage that underscore the impact of the changes introduced in the newer version.*** ### version 1.41.1: [pprof-heap-27164.pb.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16884093/pprof-heap-27164.pb.gz) ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bf547be1-3e77-4edb-aa6f-53dc8c8af6d5) ### Version 1.42.0: [pprof-heap-21911.pb.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16884096/pprof-heap-21911.pb.gz) ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1ad9d21d-a82b-449a-9801-d7593b4ab230) ### Expected behavior **Error:** JavaScript heap out-of-memory error - **Memory Usage**: When running a large number of tests (~1000) with Playwright 1.41.1, memory consumption remains stable and within the allocated limits (e.g., 8 GB). The tests complete successfully without encountering out-of-memory errors. - **Performance**: Playwright should handle large test suites efficiently, with memory usage being proportional to the number of tests executed. - **Stability**: Playwright should not exhibit significant changes in memory consumption or performance issues after minor version upgrades. ### Actual behavior 1. **Memory Consumption:** After upgrading to Playwright 1.44.1, there is a substantial increase in memory consumption when running a large number of tests, leading to JavaScript heap out-of-memory (OOM) errors. Memory usage significantly exceeds what was observed in Playwright 1.41.1. 2. **Performance:** Due to increased memory consumption, Playwright fails to complete test executions within the available memory limits, resulting in test failures and performance degradation. ### Additional context ### Overview After upgrading Playwright from version 1.41.1 to 1.44.1 within our large monorepo, we have encountered a substantial increase in memory consumption. This issue has manifested during our test runs. ### Problem Details When running approximately 1000 tests in a single shard with 8 GB of memory, Playwright fails with a JavaScript heap out-of-memory (OOM) error. ### Error Message We are receiving the following error message: **pprof-profiling with playwright 1.41** [pprof-heap-40490.pb.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16883832/pprof-heap-40490.pb.gz) **pprof-profiling with playwright 1.42** [pprof-heap-17561.pb.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16883836/pprof-heap-17561.pb.gz) ### Issue Overview: #### Problem: After upgrading to Playwright 1.44.1, we observed a significant increase in memory usage and experienced heap out-of-memory issues during large-scale test executions. #### Root Cause Identification: Through memory profiling we isolated the issue to ```loadTsConfig``` located in ```playwright/lib/third_party/tsconfig-loader.js``` Increase in memory consumption appears to be associated with changes introduced in **Playwright 1.42**. Updated code significantly altered how configurations are loaded and managed, including handling arrays of configurations and recursively loading references. These changes have led to a noticeable increase in memory consumption, which is impacting performance. ### Relevant PR: For more details, you can refer to the changes introduced in this **PR:** [feat(tsconfig): respect tsconfig references by pavelfeldman · Pull Request #29330 · microsoft/playwright](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/29330/files) This PR outlines the modifications that are contributing to the memory increase issue. ## Steps Taken: ### Profiling with pprof: We utilized pprof to profile memory usage and identify hotspots. Through profiling we identified that loadAndValidateTsconfigsForFile() method as a major contributor to high memory usage. ### Comparison with Previous Version: We compared memory usage between Playwright 1.41.1 and 1.42+ by profiling both versions. This comparison highlighted noticeable increase in memory consumption. ### Patch Implementation: To validate our findings, we applied a temporary workaround by reverting to the logic used in Playwright 1.41.1. This adjustment successfully mitigated the memory issues and allowed our tests to pass. You can refer to the changes in the patch file: [playwright+1.44.1.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16883941/playwright%2B1.44.1.patch) ### Request for Assistance: We seek your guidance or a potential fix to address the increased memory consumption observed with Playwright 1.42. Your review of the provided repository and profiling data should help in understanding and resolving the issue. ### Environment ```shell System: OS: macOS 14.6.1 CPU: (10) arm64 Apple M1 Max Memory: 117.05 MB / 32.00 GB Binaries: Node: 18.20.1 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v18.20.1/bin/node Yarn: 3.6.1-git.20240213.hash-589266c04 - ~/.local/bin/yarn npm: 10.2.4 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/bin/npm IDEs: VSCode: 1.92.2 - /usr/local/bin/code Languages: Bash: 5.2.26 - /opt/homebrew/bin/bash npmPackages: @playwright/experimental-ct-core: 1.44.1 => 1.44.1 @playwright/experimental-ct-react: 1.44.1 => 1.44.1 @playwright/experimental-ct-react17: 1.44.1 => 1.44.1 @playwright/test: 1.44.1 => 1.44.1 playwright: 1.44.1 => 1.44.1 playwright-core: 1.44.1 => 1.44.1 ```
